rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when someone feels socially uncomfortable or awkward because they are aware of themselves.

example.english: I felt self-conscious when I hosted a show for the first time.
example.traditional: 我第一次上台做主持，成個人都覺得唔自在。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dai6 jat1 ci3 soeng5 toi1 zou6 zyu2 ci4 sing4 go3 jan4 dou1 gok3 dak1 m4 zi6 zoi6

rows.note: Use this when the self-consciousness specifically feels like shyness or embarrassment in front of other people.

example.english: The child felt self-conscious and hid behind me.
example.traditional: 小朋友第一次見到咁多人，怕醜到匿喺我身後。
example.jyutping: siu2 pang4 jau5 dai6 jat1 ci3 gin3 dou2 gam3 do1 jan4 paa3 cau2 dou2 nik1 hai2 ngo5 san1 hau6

rows.jyutping: hou2 gaai3 ji3 jan4 dei6 dim2 tai2 zi6 gei2
rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on being overly concerned about how other people judge one's appearance or behaviour.

example.english: They are self-conscious about how people see them, so they do not dare wear bright clothes.
example.traditional: 佢好介意人哋點睇自己，所以唔敢着鮮色衫。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hou2 gaai3 ji3 jan4 dei6 dim2 tai2 zi6 gei2 so2 ji5 m4 gam2 zoek6 sin1 sik1 saam1
